title: Smoked Cod Skewers with Aromatic Spice
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the delicate taste of cod with aromatic spices and a smoky touch. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: aromatic
ingredients.notes: A mix of paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder

ingredients.name: skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: 2. Cut the cod fillets into 1-inch cubes.
3. In a small bowl, mix together aromatic and smoked spices.
4. Thread a piece of cod, a few tentacles of squid, and a sprinkle of spice onto each skewer.
5. Brush the skewers with a little oil and season with salt.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes on each side, or until the fish is cooked through.
7. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or lemon wedges.
